name: ob1-vendored-tests

scripts.sync-auth: for d in _shared consolidation-workers/_shared ../recipes/editorial-policy/_shared; do cp ../server-portable/auth.ts "$d/auth.ts"; done

comment: Test-only, for the vendored recipe and integration servers (SMD-1252, FORK.md change 64; this directory since SMD-3747, which moved the suites and this install here from extensions/, where the extension servers lived until SMD-2311 made all six plugins). test-auth.ts imports the vendored recipes' and integrations' servers as deployed (change 67, SMD-1455); test-writes.ts (change 69, SMD-1228; change 71, SMD-1524) drives the vendored writers of a thought's content or vector against a real Postgres. This install is hono and zod alone (STACK in db/test-support.ts), one set across the tree's installs (this directory's, server-portable's, mcp-server's), and test-auth.ts fails on drift or on any package beside them. Bump them across all three in the same commit. The v1 MCP pair, @modelcontextprotocol/sdk and @hono/mcp, left it with SMD-3747: no vendored server on this install imports an MCP package (the Vercel recipe's route has its own), and test-auth fails one that does, since new operations on the brain are a plugin. server-portable and mcp-server are on the v2 scoped packages (SMD-2278). The integrations sit under this install; recipes/node_modules is a committed link to it, so a recipe run from a checkout resolves it too (SMD-1991). No types package: bun runs the test untyped, and nothing type-checks this directory. `bun run sync-auth` rewrites every _shared/auth.ts from server-portable/auth.ts; the test names the three and fails if one differs.
